Contact

# Contact the archive

This archive is maintained by a small editorial team. The fastest way to reach us is email; corrections get priority because a wrong attribution spreads faster than its correction.

Corrections are answered first. Questions about method next.

## Report a quotation error

If a passage on this site is misquoted, misattributed, or wrongly located, write to [kyreemeng@gmail.com](mailto:kyreemeng@gmail.com) with three things: the page address, the edition you are checking against, and the passage as that edition prints it. Corrections that name a checkable edition are acted on directly; the [corrections log](https://www.philosophydef.com/editorial-policy#corrections-log) records every change with its date.

## Ask about a source

If you cannot find the source of a quotation that is not in the archive, the [sourcing hub](https://www.philosophydef.com/quote-source) documents the three-step method this archive uses, and the [thinker sourcing profiles](https://www.philosophydef.com/quote-source) record the specific citation hazards of the most-quoted philosophers. Questions the archive's records cannot answer are exactly the ones the method is written for.

## Reuse and licensing

The quotations themselves belong to their authors and translators. The verification records, source notes, and interpretive text written for this archive may be quoted with attribution and a link to the record you used. For anything larger, ask first.

## Editor

**kyree**. Maintains Philosophy Defined and the source records in this archive.
